## Change type

- [ ] Fix an incorrect, outdated, or dead link
- [ ] Improve an existing resource description or foundational guidance
- [ ] Add a carefully verified, established resource (exceptional; see CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Evidence (required for new listings)

- Official or canonical URL:
- Independent technical review, adoption, or reproduction evidence:
- Why existing listed resources are insufficient:
- Does this duplicate another entry? If so, why should both exist?

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and understand unsolicited vendor/self-promotional listings are not accepted, including open-source tools.
- [ ] Changes use neutral language; links are canonical and contain no referral parameters.
- [ ] New entries have independent evidence; author claims and star counts alone are insufficient.
- [ ] I updated English and Chinese READMEs for new entries, or explained why not.
- [ ] I understand the maintainers may close a listing request without merging.
